scripts.dev:clean: sh -c 'for p in 4000 5173 5174; do if command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsof -ti tcp:$p | xargs -r kill -9; elif command -v fuser >/dev/null 2>&1; then fuser -k ${p}/tcp >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; done' && npm run dev
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:client
scripts.build: npm --prefix capstone-client run build && npm --prefix capstone-api run build
